basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old graphic designer living in the Upper East Side of Manhattan. I'm a huge fan of the arts and culture here in NYC. I enjoy spending my weekends exploring local cafes and parks with my partner. I'm also a big fan of alternative music scenes, which is why I follow subreddits like scenekids and pond. My weekdays are mostly occupied with work, but I usually find time to browse Reddit in the evenings. I'm passionate about tech gadgets and recently got into GMRS radio as a hobby.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design, and I've been working in the field for 7 years. Over the years, I've self-taught a lot about digital marketing and user experience design. I also have a burgeoning interest in sound engineering, which I explore through online courses and community discussions.
